payload.title: FlashInfer Integration of TensorRT-LLM Cubin Kernels
payload.summary: Technical analysis of how FlashInfer integrates TensorRT-LLM's optimized kernels via cubin dynamic loading, without importing the entire TRT-LLM source tree. Covers the MoE module as a case study.

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
sections.gist: FlashInfer elegantly integrates TensorRT-LLM's optimized kernels into its own ecosystem without bundling the entire TRT-LLM source.

sections.heading: 2. TensorRT-LLM Gen System
sections.gist: TRT-LLM Gen is NVIDIA's code generation system that automatically produces highly optimized CUDA kernels.

sections.heading: 3. Integration Architecture
sections.gist: **Layered responsibilities:** Interface layer (PyTorch-compatible API) → Dispatch layer (kernel selection and parameter validation) → Execution layer (coordinating routing + MoE kernels) → Loading layer (dynamic cubin management).

sections.heading: 7. Summary
sections.gist: Through header file copying + namespace isolation + remote cubin repository + JIT callbacks, FlashInfer uses TRT-LLM Gen system's highly optimized kernels without importing TRT-LLM source.
